This topic is part of the IB HL IBDP Economics specification.

The Global Economy appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

The IB HL board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with The Global Economy.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
